style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: he crosses the frame every beat; camera arcs round him, new shot size each beat; never wide
character: a palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, long thin fingers, huge amber eyes, loose office tie, alarmed; with him ONE fat toad banker, throat ballooning, never still
props: ONE oak desk; ONE long blank schedule roll; ONE red stamp; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: roll in frame all clip; its end in his fists from 5.95; red print on it from 7.2; stamp with toad all clip
environment: a bank office, sunlit oak panelling, a tall bright pane behind

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, alarmed, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-EE gla-ZA, VEE-dyat, o-SO-ben-no, SRO-ki, ot-da-VAT stress last, KA-zhet-sya, u-ZHE, ZAV-tra
audio.pacing: 0.9-6.85 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.85 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: paper unspooling, stamp thump, paper slap, croak

timeline.a: he springs off the toad's shoulder across the desk; the toad flings the roll open beneath him
he lands on the unspooling paper, scampering after its end; the toad breathes on the stamp
he scampers along the desk, skidding nose to nose with the toad, who puffs its throat
timeline.c: HE fills half the frame, 90° arc round him

timeline.a: he scuttles backward along the desk, head snapping back, glaring; the toad swats the desk behind him
he zigzags along the desk edge, fingers drumming the roll; the toad hops alongside, waving the stamp
he dives across the desk beside the ducking toad
timeline.c: orbit, he fills half the frame

timeline.a: he lands on the roll, sprinting along it, loops bouncing; the stamp thumps behind his heels
he scampers round the toad's flank, palm dragging its belly; the toad puffs and spins after him
he snatches the roll's end and dashes back along the desk, paper unrolling; the toad turns its body after him
he springs sideways across the desk, roll end taut in his fists; the toad lunges, thumping the stamp red onto the roll at 7.2
he lands on the desk end, scuttling backward, yanking the roll; the toad skids after it
he whirls round, slapping the stamped end over the toad's face; it croaks, topples back
timeline.c: close, half circle with his whirl

timeline.a: he peels the stamped end off its face, hops to the near desk edge, glaring back, red print up in both hands; the toad gasps
timeline.c: waist up, over half the frame, short arc

timeline.a: he circles the toad along the desk, red print held up in both hands

must_appear: him round the toad 5.25, red stamp onto the roll 7.2, stamped end over the toad's face 8.2, him waist-up with it 8.9-9.5
